_readme: Model configs for the VAG bake-off. Each config = one competitor: a name, an optional pipeline profile, and a model_config injected per run (VAG B2 routing — no env flips or redeploys between configs). Cheap-model configs need the deployment's OPENAI_BASE_URL pointed at the chosen provider (OpenRouter/Fireworks/DeepSeek direct) with a matching OPENAI_API_KEY, and BOSS_MODEL_PRICES_JSON entries for accurate $/verified-outcome.
